Project Summary – ECHOES BEYOND EARTH

Team Name: EVOLV
Team Members: Lamiya Sabna and Aarsha Gopinath

Echoes Beyond Earth is an educational digital archive proposed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It explores NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, including landers, rovers and scientific instruments.

The platform will feature interactive maps, individual equipment profiles and timelines showcasing mission histories, scientific contributions and known present status. Using NASA mission archives and scientific records, it aims to present accurate information through engaging storytelling.

The project highlights these machines not as forgotten objects, but as valuable records of human curiosity, engineering and scientific discovery. It aims to make space exploration more accessible and inspire students and young learners.
details:
Project Details – ECHOES BEYOND EARTH

Echoes Beyond Earth is an educational digital archive that explores NASA’s equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It focuses on landers, rovers, descent stages and scientific instruments that have contributed to space exploration.

The project aims to present the history of these objects through interactive maps, equipment profiles and mission timelines. Users can explore different landing locations, learn why each piece of equipment was sent into space, understand its scientific contributions and discover its known present status.

The main benefit of this project is making space exploration history easier and more interesting to understand, especially for students and young learners. It highlights how even equipment that has completed its mission continues to hold scientific and historical value.

The creative aspect is combining storytelling with scientific information to transform forgotten space equipment into stories of human curiosity, engineering and discovery.

NASA mission archives, scientific records and orbital images will be used as information sources. The digital platform is intended to provide an accessible and engaging learning experience.
